Definition
[Summable Banach space-valued function] ↗ def:integral-of-simple-function 1. appE:E.5-def-6\group Vector-Valued Integration

A function $f:[0,T]\to X$ is summable if there are simple functions $\{ s_k\} _{k=1}^\infty $ such that \[ (7)\qquad \int _0^T\| s_k(t)-f(t)\| \, dt\to 0 \qquad (k\to \infty ). \]
